VARYING DEPENDING, LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF, DATA RECORDS, LINAGE with FOOTING/TOP/BOTTOM, CODE-SET) and nothing outside it (a REPORT clause makes it Format 3; no 2002-only clause).
